title: Spokane Wildfires Destroy Hundreds of Buildings as 60,000 People Evacuate
summary: Firefighters were hopeful that improving weather conditions in Washington state could help efforts to contain the blaze, which officials described as the largest natural disaster in the history of Spokane.
